description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdmAdapter, testing decryption and transformation functions using Google Test framework. It mocks the OpenCDMSession and verifies behavior of session decryption and caps transformation.

classes.name: OpenCdmAdapterTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for OpenCdmAdapter unit tests, setting up mock session and buffers.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptWhenSessionIsNull
methods.description: Tests that decryption fails when the session pointer is null.

methods.name: ShouldDecrypt
methods.description: Tests successful decryption when the mock session adds protection metadata correctly.

methods.name: ShouldTransformCaps
methods.description: Tests the caps transformation function returns success.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptBufferWhenSessionIsNull
methods.description: Tests decryption buffer failure when session pointer is null.

methods.name: ShouldFailToDecryptBufferWhenOperationFails
methods.description: Tests decryption buffer failure when addProtectionMeta returns false.

methods.name: ShouldDecryptBuffer
methods.description: Tests successful decryption buffer when addProtectionMeta returns true.
